classification_definitions.internal_engineering: Must be designed, implemented, tested, and packaged by Blind Ledger; outside help is not a closure dependency.
classification_definitions.security_audit_gate: The one independent assurance gate after all internal engineering packages close.
classification_definitions.activation_input: A live credential, endpoint, signer, account, or authorization supplied to the finished release; not missing engineering.

blockers.title: Production native STARK prover and verifier
blockers.exit_criteria: The complete native STARK prover and independent verifier lane is internally implemented, reproducible, pinned, and qualified for the exact statement, suite, sidecar, and public-input schema, with a per-proof candidate identity in BUILT_AUDIT_PENDING; the global operational proofSuiteId remains unset until deployed acceptance and audit.

blockers.title: Final independent Security Audit Gate
blockers.exit_criteria: One independent audit covers AIR soundness, witness hiding/PQ, wide-state cryptography, implementation/contracts/rollup/supply chain, and privacy/side-channel/operations; all critical and high findings are closed or formally accepted for the exact release identities.

blockers.title: Exact claim-proof output and settlement ABI binding
blockers.exit_criteria: One real verifier authenticates the exact versioned 12-field output and full sidecar consumed by settlement; length, order, encoding, proof format, suite, schema, and verifier identities are reproducibly pinned, and no caller-supplied unproven value can advance state.

blockers.title: Privacy V2 circuit and settlement migration
blockers.exit_criteria: The parallel V2 proof and settlement path removes exact amounts, counts, decisions, PHI, and claim ciphertext from public data; differential, inference, known-answer, attack, migration, and rollback tests pass.

blockers.title: Ethereum-settled based validity-rollup stack
blockers.exit_criteria: R01-R12 pass the local/synthetic boundary: pinned baseline/future-shadow manifest, multi-node fixture, exact claim envelope, L2 transition-proof fixture, finalized settlement, based ordering, commitment-only DA, bridge, forced inclusion, exits, governed migration, and rollback. A real client deployment and production claim verifier remain separate blockers.

blockers.title: Provider-neutral PQ KMS/HSM and private-data operations
blockers.exit_criteria: Provider-neutral KMS/HSM ports, software/reference implementations, conformance tests, isolated worker deployment, authorization, audit, rotation, retention, legal-hold, backup, crash-recovery, destruction, and crypto-erasure controls are implemented and pass local/sandbox qualification.

blockers.title: Zero-knowledge witness-hiding proof backend
blockers.progress: RISC Zero 3.0.5 verified the exact 12-field commitment envelope as a semantic oracle. R33 freezes the complete nonactivating 16-table relation IR and exact K128/K256/K512 interface dimensions. The selected production path is a theorem-matched sibling Circle-STARK engine with concrete SHA3-512 PCS/FRI ports, internally implemented native hiding, and strict-PQ qualification; the rejected QM31/Blake2s suite remains nonactivatable.
blockers.exit_criteria: The complete claim backend internally implements and qualifies native zero-knowledge witness hiding; leakage tests cover proof and metadata artifacts; the exact suite reaches BUILT_AUDIT_PENDING.

blockers.title: Human governance signer enrollment
blockers.exit_criteria: Authorized operators supply multisig signers and run the shipped enrollment, recovery, timelock, audit, and rollback procedures against the audited release.

blockers.title: Live government and oracle endpoint activation
blockers.exit_criteria: Authorized operators supply official endpoint versions, credentials, source identities, signing keys, epochs, and governed roots to adapters that already passed I01-I08 local/sandbox conformance.

blockers.title: Payment and jurisdictional authorization
blockers.exit_criteria: Authorized operators supply the approved pilot jurisdiction, payment accounts, limits, and legal/compliance authorization to the audited release without changing product code.
